seller_or_subject: Medium — Hazel Paradise compares Gumroad's "Discover" vs Payhip
what: A creator notes that Gumroad's "Discover" feature generates organic sales, and compares fee structures: Payhip 5% vs Gumroad 10%.
verbatim_snippet: "Pricing — Payhip takes 5% per transaction and Gumroad takes 10% per transaction" … "Discover Option — I didn't know this before until I got a sale from Gumroad itself. Yes, people go directly to Gumroad to buy products."
notes: Provides comparative marketplace discovery context. Author uses both platforms. Original ID: C2.
